_about: Scoring rules for risk/score_contracts.py. Category risk levels come from evaluation/risk_categories.csv; this file holds everything else, so weights can be changed without touching code. Category names are matched ignoring case and spaces.

severity_floor._about: Signal 2: a High-risk clause detected with at least this confidence puts the contract in at least this bucket, whatever its total score.

missing_protections._about: Signal 3: points added when a protective clause is absent (and, if 'present' is given, only when that clause is detected).
missing_protections.name: No cap on liability

combinations._about: Signal 4: points added when all listed clauses are detected, scaled by the lowest confidence among them.
combinations.name: Exclusive and committed to minimum purchases
Renews unless notice is given by a deadline

buckets._about: Cutoffs are percentiles of the scores of the 408 training contracts (CUAD annotations), then applied to the scored contracts.

evidence_rules._about: Model mode only. A matching clause-specific pattern qualifies any model detection; it can also backstop a missed detection at the listed confidence. Patterns are checked across each contract's chunks, and the matching chunk is retained as evidence.
evidence_rules.name: Control or ownership event with contractual consequence
Termination without cause or at a party's discretion
Notice deadline linked to ending or declining renewal
Service or support obligation continuing after termination
Express uncapped or unlimited liability language
